capabilities: Embed the dsh agent web UI in a side panel
Spawn a dsh subprocess bound to the vault root
Register the vault as a dsh workspace
Reap orphaned dsh processes from crashed sessions
Locate dsh and Node binaries across common install paths
extras: Marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only (Obsidian 1.13.0+). Runs a loopback-only local HTTP server and discloses file access outside the vault; the plugin itself makes no network calls except an opt-in npm/pnpm install of recommended dsh plugins.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run a vault-aware AI agent that can operate on vault files and persist agent memory inside the vault.

relations.evidence: Host DeepSeek Harness (dsh) inside Obsidian — let the dsh agent read and write your Vault files
dsh-market — a visual plugin marketplace inside the dsh web UI

requires.name: dsh CLI and Node.js 22.20+, installed globally
LLM provider credentials configured in ~/.dsh/ (e.g. DeepSeek, OpenAI-compatible endpoints)

summary: Hosts the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) agent inside Obsidian, letting it read and write vault files and keep working memory in the vault.
